text: PPY Production AB belongs to a group; its parent company is Saelma & Co AB.
short: PPY Production AB's parent company is Saelma & Co AB.

source.name: Allabolag: PPY Production AB (org.nr 556689-6857)
source.quote: PPY Production AB ingår i en koncern. Moderbolaget är Saelma & Co AB.
source.note: Translation: 'PPY Production AB is part of a group. The parent company is Saelma & Co AB.' Allabolag cites Bolagsverket and UC AB.
